Reasoning: This stage keeps the panda_fingertip gripper open, preserves its current world-frame orientation, and moves the panda_fingertip frame origin to the cube_2 object-frame origin as the contact target. The reach_point tolerance is 0.01 m for contact setup. The reach_point condition includes both geometry and manipulator_high_effort to represent the supported stop alternatives: reaching within 0.01 m of cube_2 or detecting contact/high effort during the approach. No tool +z or +y axis alignment constraint is added. End-effector pose and gripper joint-state feedback are represented by the reach/freeze and open-gripper terms; gripper/contact effort feedback is represented only through the available manipulator_high_effort condition label, since there is no separate gripper-effort signal-selection operator.
